I'm Ifunanya Obiefuna, an AWS Cloud Engineer focused on building reliable, secure, and cost-conscious infrastructure for modern businesses. I work across the full AWS stack, from networking and compute to serverless architecture and storage.

My approach is grounded in the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Every decision I make whether architecting for fault tolerance, tightening IAM policies, or eliminating unnecessary spend, is intentional and tied to business outcomes.

I'm available for freelance and contract engagements, working remotely with clients globally.

Lambda API Gateway DynamoDB IAM Python

Serverless URL Shortener

Built a fully serverless URL shortener on AWS with zero idle cost. A POST request generates a unique short code stored in DynamoDB and returns a live short URL. A GET request triggers Lambda to perform a 301 redirect The architecture is fully event-driven with no servers running 24/7.

Services Used
Amazon S3 S3 Versioning SSE-S3 Lifecycle Rules Data Protection

S3 Data Protection with Versioning, Encryption and Lifecycle Policies

Configured a private S3 bucket with enterprise-grade data protection. Enabled versioning to preserve every file version for recovery, applied SSE-S3 server-side encryption so all objects are encrypted at rest, and created an automated lifecycle rule to permanently delete noncurrent versions after 30 days for cost optimisation.

Bucket Versioning enabled on ifunanya-data-protection-demo

Lifecycle rule delete-old-versions enabled on entire bucket

AWS IAM IAM Policies IAM Roles IAM User Groups Least Privilege

IAM Roles, Policies and User Groups

Built a complete IAM security model from scratch. Created a custom JSON policy granting least-privilege S3 read-only access, an EC2 IAM role so instances can access S3 without storing credentials, a user group with the policy attached for scalable permission management, and a demo user inheriting permissions through the group.

Amazon VPC Subnets Internet Gateway Route Tables Networking

Custom VPC with Public and Private Subnets

Designed and built a production-style network from scratch on AWS. Created a custom VPC with a 10.0.0.0/16 CIDR block, provisioned a public subnet (10.0.1.0/24) and private subnet (10.0.2.0/24) across different Availability Zones, attached an Internet Gateway, configured a public route table routing all outbound traffic through the IGW, and enabled auto-assign public IPv4 on the public subnet.

Auto Scaling Group with Application Load Balancer

Built a production-grade high availability architecture on AWS. Created a Launch Template with Amazon Linux 2023 and Apache user data, provisioned an Application Load Balancer across two Availability Zones, configured a Target Group routing HTTP traffic to EC2 instances, and deployed an Auto Scaling Group that automatically maintains 2 instances with a minimum of 1 and maximum of 4 based on demand.
